findings.message: Apply rotation in the active DOM renderer. The web app registers `createDomRendererPlugin()`, which renders `packages/dom-renderer/src/dom-shape-layer.tsx`, not this `ShapeLayer`. Consequently, shapes with nonzero rotation still appear unrotated in the app, while the newly wrapped hit tests and spatial bounds treat them as rotated. For example, a rectangular sticky note rotated 90 degrees can no longer be selected across its visible extent. Apply the transform in the active renderer as well.
